  "summary": "HPE faces broad-based competition across all four segments, with Dell Technologies and Cisco Systems appearing as rivals in nearly every business line, alongside Super Micro, Lenovo, Fujitsu, and Atos in servers/HPC. In hybrid cloud it competes with Broadcom, IBM, NetApp, Nutanix, Pure Storage and hyperscalers (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure), while networking pits it against Cisco, Arista, Nokia, Huawei, Ciena, NVIDIA, Extreme, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Zscaler, Netskope, Ruckus, Ubiquiti and NaaS startups Nile and Meter. Financial Services competes with captive financiers (IBM Global Financing, Dell Financial Services, Cisco Capital) and ITAD providers ERI, Ingram Micro, Sage Sustainable Electronics, and Sims Recycling Solutions."
